subject: Ciências
description_pt: Relacionar diferentes leituras do céu e explicações sobre a origem da Terra, do Sol ou do Sistema Solar às necessidades de distintas culturas (agricultura, caça, mito, orientação espacial e temporal etc.).

components.description_pt: Identificar diferentes formas culturais de ler e interpretar o céu em distintas sociedades
components.description_en: Identify different cultural ways of reading and interpreting the sky across distinct societies
components.cc_component_description: Compare how different societies developed based on the resources available in their environments

components.description_pt: Relacionar diversas explicações sobre a origem da Terra, do Sol ou do Sistema Solar a necessidades culturais específicas
components.description_en: Relate diverse explanations for the origin of Earth, the Sun, or the Solar System to specific cultural needs
components.cc_component_description: Use the nebular hypothesis model to account for the observed structure of the solar system

components.description_pt: Comparar como diferentes culturas utilizam conhecimento astronômico para agricultura, navegação ou mitologia
components.description_en: Compare how different cultures use astronomical knowledge for agriculture, navigation, or mythology
components.cc_component_description: Compare how different societies developed based on the resources available in their environments

cc_matches.description: Resource availability has guided the development of human society.
The solar system appears to have formed from a disk of dust and gas, drawn together by gravity.
